usage.finalMessage:
`quote` now gives a payable-by date of today plus 21 days, per DEC-B12, and `help` lists it right after `invoice`. `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes 9 of 9, and the work is committed in `a6028ea`.
Open question (DEC-W-2 was rejected): `invoice` still uses the old 30-day rule from DEC-B01, so a quote and an invoice issued the same day show different dates. Finance needs to decide whether `invoice` moves to 21 days, which would also mean updating the existing 30-day test. I didn't touch the invoice code, and I dropped the planned 30-day invoice test because it depended on DEC-W-2.
OUTCOME: completed
